question: Which of the following is one of the metals used in LED semiconductor technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gallium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gallium is one of the metals used in LED semiconductor technology**__.

 __
 
• A light-emitting diode (LED) is a semiconductor light source that emits light when current is passed through it.
 
• Gallium is the first and primary element used in the manufacture of almost all semiconductor LED devices.
 
• Gallium is a metallic material found as a trace element in coal, bauxite and other minerals.
 
• The symbol for gallium is "Ga" - (atomic number 31).
 
• The specialty semiconductors used for LED manufacturing are **gallium arsenide (GaAs), gallium phosphide (GaP), or gallium arsenide phosphide (GaAsP**).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indium gallium nitride (InGaN): blue, green and ultraviolet high-brightness LEDs
 
• Aluminum gallium indium phosphide (AlGaInP): yellow, orange and red high-brightness LEDs
 
• Aluminum gallium arsenide (AlGaAs): red and infrared LEDs
